meanings.usage: 可指法律上的公正审判，也可指抽象的正义概念
指复杂的组织或机构系统
形容需要付出大量努力的困难工作或旅程
与具体事物相对的，存在于概念中的
形容声音被压抑或减弱的
指吸引人做某事的力量或冲动
指确定某物的确切位置
指从某处出来或显露出来
指开始进行一项工作或任务
指用工具凿开或削去材料
指从一种用途或形式改变为另一种

meanings.meaning: 比较级前可以加修饰词，表示程度

phrases.usage: 表示正义已经得到伸张或实现

examples.en: Justice has been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

phrases.usage: 表示某人自食其果、活该倒霉

examples.en: The shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
examples.zh: 店员们一定会觉得忍不住想说'他活该'。

examples.en: The manager promptly rang up the fire brigade.
examples.zh: 经理立刻给消防队打了电话。

examples.en: He had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
examples.zh: 他试图在夜间闯入商店，但卡在了烟囱里。

examples.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

examples.en: We are, in part, admitting that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord.
examples.zh: 我们在某种程度上承认，某些环境因素使得正义能够自行发挥作用。

phrases.usage: 毫无疑问地；确定无疑地

examples.en: We might say that justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.
examples.zh: 当一个人的清白或罪行被毫无疑问地证实后，我们可以说正义得到了伸张。

examples.en: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure that they will find it.
examples.zh: 那些寻求正义的人，踏上了艰难的旅程，而且永远无法确定他们能否找到它。

examples.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning.
examples.zh: 一天早上，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的场所内被抓时。

phrases.usage: 通过做某事使某人获救

examples.en: The fire fighters were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 消防队员最终通过在墙上凿开一个大洞将他救了出来。

/ɒv wʌnz əʊn əˈkɔːd/ phrase. 出于自愿；自动地（指在没有外部压力的情况下自己去做某事）
/miːt aʊt/ verb phrase. 给予；实施（惩罚等）（指分配或给予奖惩）

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: be + 过去分词 (be + past participle)
grammar.definition: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时使用被动语态。主动语态中动作的执行者（agent）可以用by引出，但经常被省略。 用于强调动作的承受者，或动作执行者不明确、不重要时。

examples.en: Justice has been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

examples.en: The shop was an old converted house.
examples.zh: 那家商店是一栋改建的老房子。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或状态持续到现在，或对现在有影响。常与already, just, yet, for, since等词连用。 用于表示过去的动作与现在有关联，或动作已发生但强调其结果。

examples.en: The cry was repeated several times.
He had been there for nearly ten hours.
examples.zh: 他在那里已经呆了将近十个小时。

examples.en: She ran to tell the manager who promptly rang up the fire brigade.
examples.zh: 她跑去告诉经理，经理立刻给消防队打了电话。

grammar.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.structure: 名词/代词 + 关系词 + 从句
grammar.definition: 用于修饰名词或代词的从句，由关系代词（who, whom, which, that）或关系副词（where, when, why）引导。 用于提供关于某人或某物的额外信息。

examples.en: The cry had certainly come from one of the chimneys, but as there were so many of them, the firemen could not be certain which one it was.
examples.zh: 哭喊声确实是从某个烟囱里传来的，但由于烟囱太多，消防员无法确定是哪一个。

examples.en: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey.
examples.zh: 那些寻求正义的人，踏上了艰难的旅程。

imitations.en: It serves you right for being late.
It serves her right for not studying.

patterns.pattern: Someone + be + unable to + 动词原形

original.en: As it was extremely narrow, the man was unable to move.
original.zh: 由于烟囱非常狭窄，这个人无法动弹。

imitations.en: She was unable to attend the meeting.
I was unable to solve the problem.

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主句

original.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning, the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
original.zh: 一天早上，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的场所内被抓时，店员们一定会觉得忍不住想说'他活该'。

imitations.en: When I was young, I used to play in the park.
imitations.zh: 当我年轻的时候，我常在公园里玩。

imitations.en: When he arrived home, it was already dark.
imitations.zh: 当他到家时，天已经黑了。

lines.en: The word justice is usually associated with courts of law.
lines.zh: “正义”这个词常常是同法庭连在一起的。

lines.en: We might say that justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.
lines.zh: 当某人被证据确凿地证明无罪的时候，我们也许会说正义得到了伸张。

lines.en: Justice is part of the complex machinery of the law.
lines.zh: 正义是复杂的法律机器组成部分。

lines.en: Those who seek it undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure that they will find it.
lines.zh: 那些寻求正义的人走的是一条崎岖的道路，从来没有把握他们最终将到正义。

lines.en: Judges, however wise or eminent , are human and can make mistakes.
lines.zh: 法官无论如何聪明与有名，毕竟也是人，也会出差错的。

lines.en: There are rare instances when justice almost ceases to be an abstract concept.
lines.zh: 在个别情况下，正义不再是一种抽象概念。

lines.en: Reward or punishment are meted out quite independent of human interference.
lines.zh: 奖惩的实施是不受人意志支配的。

lines.en: At such times, justice acts like a living force.
lines.zh: 在这种时候，正义像一种有生命的力量行使其职能。

lines.en: When we use a phrase like 'it serves him right', we are, in part, admitting that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord.
lines.zh: 当我们说“他罪有应得”这句话的时候，我们部分承认了某种特定的环境使得正义自动地起了作用。

lines.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of large jewellery store on morning, the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right.
lines.zh: 一天上午，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店里被人抓住的时候，店员一定会忍不住说：“他罪有应得。

lines.en: The shop was an old converted house with many large, disused fireplaces and tall, narrow chimneys.
lines.zh: ”那是一座老式的、经过改造的房子，店里有许多废置不用的大壁炉和又高又窄的烟囱。

lines.en: Towards midday, a girl heard a muffed cry coming from behind on of the walls.
lines.zh: 快到中午的时候，一个女售货员听见从一堵墙里传出一种闷声闷气的叫声。

lines.en: As the cry was repeated several times, she ran to tell the manager who promptly rang up the fire brigade.
lines.zh: 由于这种喊叫声重复了几次，她跑去报告经理，经理当即给消防队挂了电话。

lines.en: The cry had certainly come form one of the chimneys, but as there were so many of them, the fire fighters could not be certain which one it was.
lines.zh: 喊叫声肯定是从烟囱里传出来的，然而，因为烟囱太多，消防队员无法确定到底是哪一个。

lines.en: They located the right chimney by tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries.
lines.zh: 他们通过叫击烟囱倾叫声而确定传出声音的那个烟囱。

lines.en: After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick, they found that a man had been trapped in the chimney.
lines.zh: 他们凿透了18英寸厚的墙壁，发现有个人卡在烟囱里。

lines.en: As it was extremely narrow, the man was unable to move, but the fire fighters were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
lines.zh: 由于烟囱太窄，那人无法动弹。消防队员在墙上挖了个大洞，才终于把他解救出来。

lines.en: The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged, admitted at once that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
lines.zh: 那个看来满脸沮丧、浑身漆黑的家伙从烟囱里一出来，就承认头天夜里他企图到店里行窍，但让烟囱卡住了。

lines.en: He had been there for nearly ten hours.
lines.zh: 他已经在烟囱里被困了将近10个小时。

lines.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
lines.zh: 甚至在那人还没被送交给警察之前，正义就已得到了伸张。

questions.q: The word 'justice' is given two different meanings in the text. What is the distinction between them?
questions.zh: 课文中 justice 一词有两种不同含义，它们的区别是什么？
questions.a: In the first sense justice is an abstract concept belonging to courts of law: justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt. In the second sense justice acts like a living force that operates of its own accord — reward or punishment is meted out quite independent of human interference, as when the thief got stuck in the chimney and everyone said 'It serves him right.'
questions.aZh: 第一种含义是把 justice 看作属于法庭的抽象概念：当一个人的无罪或有罪被确凿证明时，人们便说正义得到了伸张。第二种含义是把它看作一种自行其是的有生命的力量——奖惩的实施不受人的意志支配，正如小偷卡在烟囱里、人人都说他罪有应得那样。
questions.hint: 答案线索在课文开头三段与结尾一段：前者关键词是 courts of law、proved beyond doubt、complex machinery of the law，后者是 a living force、of its own accord。

questions.q: Why did the shop assistants find it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'It serves him right'?
questions.zh: 为什么店员们忍不住想说“他罪有应得”？
questions.a: Because a thief had been caught on the premises of the large jewellery store that morning — his own action, not a court, had brought him down.
questions.aZh: 因为那天上午一个贼就在这家大珠宝店里被人当场抓住——是他自己的行为，而不是法庭，把他送进了法网。
questions.hint: 见 'When a thief was caught on the premises of large jewellery store on morning...' 一句，注意 premises 指店堂、场所。

questions.q: How did the fire fighters locate the right chimney, and how did they finally free the man?
questions.zh: 消防队员是怎样找到正确的烟囱、又怎样最终把那个人解救出来的？
questions.a: They located the right chimney by tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries. After chipping through a wall eighteen inches thick, they freed him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
questions.aZh: 他们敲击墙壁、听那人的喊叫声，从而确定了正确的烟囱。他们凿透一堵十八英寸厚的墙后，在墙上挖了个大洞才把他解救出来。
questions.hint: 见 'They located the right chimney by tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries.' 与 'by cutting a huge hole in the wall'。

questions.q: What did the blackened figure admit as soon as he emerged from the chimney?
questions.zh: 那个浑身漆黑的家伙从烟囱里一出来就承认了什么？
questions.a: He admitted at once that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney, and that he had been there for nearly ten hours.
questions.aZh: 他立刻承认，他前一天夜里曾企图闯进这家商店，却被卡在烟囱里，而且他已经在里面待了将近十个小时。
questions.hint: 见 'The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged, admitted at once that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.' 及下一句 'He had been there for nearly ten hours.'

questions.q: What does the last sentence mean: 'Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police'?
questions.zh: 最后一句“甚至在那人还没被送交给警察之前，正义就已得到了伸张”是什么意思？
questions.a: It means the thief was punished by the circumstances themselves rather than by a court: the abstract justice of the law had turned into a living force and acted of its own accord, so no trial was needed for him to get what he deserved.
questions.aZh: 意思是这个小偷是被环境本身、而不是被法庭惩罚的：法律中抽象的正义变成了一种有生命的力量并自行其是，所以他用不着接受审判，就已经得到了应有的下场。
questions.hint: 先回到课文前半部分的 'justice acts like a living force' 与 'justice to act of its own accord'，再看结尾的 even before the man was handed over to the police。

translation:
“正义”这个词常常是同法庭连在一起的。
当某人被证据确凿地证明无罪的时候，我们也许会说正义得到了伸张。
正义是复杂的法律机器组成部分。
那些寻求正义的人走的是一条崎岖的道路，从来没有把握他们最终将到正义。
法官无论如何聪明与有名，毕竟也是人，也会出差错的。
在个别情况下，正义不再是一种抽象概念。
奖惩的实施是不受人意志支配的。
在这种时候，正义像一种有生命的力量行使其职能。
当我们说“他罪有应得”这句话的时候，我们部分承认了某种特定的环境使得正义自动地起了作用。
一天上午，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店里被人抓住的时候，店员一定会忍不住说：“他罪有应得。
”那是一座老式的、经过改造的房子，店里有许多废置不用的大壁炉和又高又窄的烟囱。
快到中午的时候，一个女售货员听见从一堵墙里传出一种闷声闷气的叫声。
由于这种喊叫声重复了几次，她跑去报告经理，经理当即给消防队挂了电话。
喊叫声肯定是从烟囱里传出来的，然而，因为烟囱太多，消防队员无法确定到底是哪一个。
他们通过叫击烟囱倾叫声而确定传出声音的那个烟囱。
他们凿透了18英寸厚的墙壁，发现有个人卡在烟囱里。
由于烟囱太窄，那人无法动弹。
消防队员在墙上挖了个大洞，才终于把他解救出来。
那个看来满脸沮丧、浑身漆黑的家伙从烟囱里一出来，就承认头天夜里他企图到店里行窍，但让烟囱卡住了。
他已经在烟囱里被困了将近10个小时。
甚至在那人还没被送交给警察之前，正义就已得到了伸张。
title: Justice was Done
subtitle: 伸张正义

lead.question: 课文中的 justice 为什么有两种含义？从法庭断案到小偷自困烟囱，正义如何在无人干预时自己动手？
lead.warmup: 先别急着背课文。想象一个画面：一个贼夜里钻进珠宝店，却把自己卡在又高又窄的烟囱里，十个小时后被消防队员从墙里凿出来——他不落网也难。这样的结局不需要法官宣判，正如英语那句 It serves him right。课文开头谈的是法庭上的正义，结尾却让我们看到另一种更直接的正义。作者把这两种 justice 摆在一起，正是全文的关键。
goals: 掌握 justice、court of law、innocence、guilt、trial、judge、premises 等法律词汇在文中的含义
理解 justice 在课文中的两种含义：法庭上的抽象概念与自行其是的有生命的力量
复习被动语态与过去完成时（has been done / had been trapped / was handed over）在叙事中的配合
体会 however wise or eminent 的让步状语从句结构，以及 it serves him right 等固定表达
lead.summary: 课文先给 justice 下定义：它通常与法庭联系在一起，只有当一个人的无罪或有罪被确凿证明时，人们才会说正义得到了伸张。然而正义只是复杂法律机器的一部分，寻求它的人走在崎岖的路上，再聪明有名的法官也会出错。作者随后举出一个例外：当奖惩不受人的意志支配时，正义就像一种有生命的力量自行其是。小偷卡在烟囱里十个小时，正是这种正义的体现。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：however wise or eminent 中 however 相当于 no matter how，后面必须紧跟形容词或副词，不能写成 whatever wise，也不能让 however 直接接名词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：当某人的罪行被确凿证实时，我们也许会说正义得到了伸张。
exercises.a: We might say that justice has been done when a man's guilt has been proved beyond doubt.

exercises.q: 填空：A man's innocence or ______ has to be proved beyond doubt before he is sentenced by the court.（用 guilty 的正确形式）
句型转换（主动变被动）：The fire fighters cut a huge hole in the wall and freed the man.
exercises.a: A huge hole was cut in the wall and the man was freed by the fire fighters.
exercises.note: 两个动作均改用被动语态

exercises.q: 改错：The shop assistants must find it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'It serves him right.'
exercises.a: The shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'It serves him right.'
exercises.note: 对过去的推测用 must have done

exercises.q: 汉译英：那个满脸沮丧的家伙承认他夜里曾试图闯进商店，却被卡住了。
exercises.a: The sorry-looking fellow admitted that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck.
exercises.note: 宾语从句用过去完成时

exercises.q: 填空：The man ______ (hand) over to the police after he ______ (free) from the chimney.
exercises.note: 被动语态加过去完成时

exercises.q: 改错：Judges, whatever wise or eminent, are human and can make mistakes.
exercises.a: Judges, however wise or eminent, are human and can make mistakes.

quiz.q: 课文中 justice 一词被赋予的两种不同含义是：
options: the decision of a judge and the verdict of a jury
the abstract concept of law and a living force acting of its own accord
the innocence of a man and the guilt of a man
a reward for good deeds and a punishment for crimes
quiz.note: 抽象法律概念对自行其是的力量

quiz.q: 快到中午时，那位女售货员听到哭声后做了什么？
options: She tapped at the walls herself.
She rang up the fire brigade directly.
She ran to tell the manager, who promptly rang up the fire brigade.
She asked the shop assistants to keep quiet.
quiz.note: 先报经理，经理再叫消防队

quiz.q: 消防队员无法确定哭声出自哪一个烟囱，原因是什么？
options: Because the cries were repeated only once.
Because the chimney was extremely narrow.
Because the man was trapped eighteen inches deep.
Because the old converted house had so many chimneys.
quiz.note: 烟囱太多，只能敲墙细听

quiz.q: 小偷为什么会被困在烟囱里？
options: He had tried to break into the shop during the night and got stuck.
He was hiding from the police in the shop.
He had climbed up to repair the chimney.
He was locked in by the shop assistants.
quiz.note: 夜里行窃，反被烟囱卡住

quiz.q: 'Judges, however wise or eminent, are human and can make mistakes.' 意为：
options: Judges are wise and eminent, so they never make mistakes.
Even the wisest and most eminent judges can make mistakes.
Only judges who are human can be wise and eminent.
Judges become wise and eminent by making mistakes.

quiz.q: 下列哪一句与 'It serves him right' 意思最接近？
options: He has served his sentence in prison.
He did the right thing at last.
He deserves what has happened to him.
It is none of his business.
